answer_1.quote: Abstractive summarization seeks to generate concise descriptions about synoptic information of longer documents.

answer_2.quote: We report widely used ROUGE metrics , including ROUGE-1 (R-1), ROUGE-2 (R-2), and sentence-level ROUGE-L (R-L) F1 scores with rouge-score python package.

answer_4.quote: We hire human evaluators on Amazon Mechanical Turk to answer three Yes/No questions for the four summaries and rank them.
answer_4.guideline: Human evaluators answered three Yes/No questions: a) Informativeness, b) Faithfulness, c) Fluency, and ranked the summaries.
